findings.description: The vector-of-variants build matches the wildcard builds: the gzip victim after an identity-AE poison is served at zero fetches, and a no-AE attacker's overwrite (stored with vary=false because the peer sends no Vary) is then served to the next no-AE victim at zero fetches.
findings.title: e1a28e35: variant vector also serves cross-AE victims at zero fetch

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
